The 11th Virtual Congress of the Asia Pacific Initiative on Reproduction (ASPIRE 2022) was successfully held from Thursday, 28 April 2022 – Sunday, 1 May 2022.

The 10th Virtual Congress of the Asia Pacific Initiative on Reproduction (ASPIRE 2021) was successfully held from 30 April – 1 May 2021 and 8 – 9 May 2021 virtually.
